_what: The defaults do-work/apply-a-computer-row.mjs reads, never its code. `sql_runner` is the argv of the SQL tool's own process (`{workshop}` is the checkout the program runs from; the statement arrives on its stdin and the database connection on its descriptor 3). `probe` is how long the probe runs before the apply starts (`start_wait_ms`) and after it ends (`stop_after_ms`), and the most addresses it asks (`max_urls`). The person's own `--targets` file is laid over this and carries `machines` (keyed by a computer's address: ssh `known_hosts` and `identity_file`, and for a computer that serves pages the `pages_folder` whose symlinks must point into the unit's source commit) and `held_value_reader` (the argv of the program that prints a held value by vault name; the name is added last). `{home}` in those is the running person's home folder. A shared tool names no one's machine, so none is here.
